User portion has one quarter of the fried rings. No sambar or chutney is in the ingredient accounting. Shakappa et al. test vada served with sambar at a standardized 50 g carbohydrate load against glucose; that is a separate mixed meal with different scope and its GI must not replace the plain recipe estimate. Retain the approved model value, identify the food and scope, and withhold its otherwise unconditional category.
